description: Details required by Conditions 4 (works to match - sample panels required); 5) Prior to commencement of window repair works, a window repair specification including decision-making criteria for repair techniques depending on the condition of each window, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved specification; 6) Prior to installation, typical details showing how the proposed new secondary glazing will be installed, including fixing details, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details; 9) Prior to the commencement of any works to repair the masonry, a detailed specification of the lime mortar to be used for the works shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The specification shall be designed to match the original mortar as closely as possible) of Listed Building consent LB/26/00376 (Proposed repair and upgrades to roof of eastern wing and turrets, nearest to Exmoor Street: including installation of underfelt, replacing timber battens, and renewal of slate covering with Welsh slate. Replacement of asphalt covering to Juliet balconies with single ply membrane. Replacement of mini dormers to match original, with addition of flashing. Refurbishment of all external joinery, including doors, windows and timber louvres. Replacement or refurbishment of windows as required. Secondary glazing to all windows in scope. Repointing of mortar to all elevations as required. Repointing of all chimneys. Resin repairs to stone cills as required. Refurbishment or replacement of guttering and downpipes as required with cast aluminium gutters/pipework)
